text.en: The Prairie region is mostly dry. Its winters are cold and its summers are hot.
text.fr: La région des Prairies est surtout sèche. Les hivers y sont froids et les étés, chauds.

source.quote: The region is mostly dry, with cold winters and hot summers.

verification.evidence: Manitoba, Saskatchewan and Alberta are the Prairie Provinces, rich in energy resources and some of the most fertile farmland in the world. The region is mostly dry, with cold winters and hot summers.

text.en: Saskatchewan also produces oil and natural gas.
text.fr: La Saskatchewan produit aussi du pétrole et du gaz naturel.

source.quote: and produces oil and natural gas.

verification.evidence: It also boasts the world’s richest deposits of uranium and potash, used in fertilizer, and produces oil and natural gas. Regina, the capital, is home to the training academy of the Royal Canadian Mounted Police.

text.en: Alberta has more people than any other Prairie province.
text.fr: L'Alberta compte plus d'habitants que toute autre province des Prairies.

source.quote: Alberta is the most populous Prairie province.

verification.evidence: Alberta Alberta is the most populous Prairie province. The province, and the world-famous Lake Louise in the Rocky Mountains, were both named after Princess Louise Caroline Alberta, fourth daughter of Queen Victoria.

text.en: Lake Louise, in the Rocky Mountains, is famous around the world.
text.fr: Le lac Louise, dans les montagnes Rocheuses, est célèbre dans le monde entier.

source.quote: the world-famous Lake Louise in the Rocky Mountains
